The ITU G.722 codec, encode and decode part.
Source: https://doc-snapshots.qt.io/qtwebengine/qtwebengine-3rdparty-the-itu-g-722-codec-encode-and-decode-part.html
Qt documentation identifies this as Qt WebEngine 6.140.0 (6.140 branch).
The following license/notice text is extracted without rewriting its wording.
